title: Forgiveness
definition: Forgiveness is the believer's willingness to release bitterness and extend mercy because God has forgiven them in Christ.
summary: Forgiveness does not deny evil, excuse sin, or always remove consequences. It entrusts justice to God and responds to others from the mercy received in Christ.
christFocus: Christ forgave sinners at great cost and calls His people to forgive one another.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Forgiveness does not deny evil, excuse sin, or always remove consequences. It entrusts justice to God and responds to others from the mercy received in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
